profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company, traded as CRM, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2026-01-31, reports revenue of $41,525,000,000. The site material gathered for the company is Slack's AI features page, which describes AI in Slack as a way to summarize channels and threads, serve daily recaps, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and build automations. Slackbot is described as a personal AI agent in Slack that understands the user and the workspace, helps prepare for meetings, analyzes reports, and creates project briefs.

Three AI products are tracked for the company: Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Slack AI is noted as embedded in messaging with message-corpus exposure; Tableau AI is noted for business intelligence embedded AI, natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance; Einstein / Agentforce is noted as CRM-embedded AI and agents. The company says customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with the models hosted inside Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. It also describes Slack as the conversational UI for Agentforce, where agents built with Agentforce can run in channels, threads, and direct messages.

The held facts record 270 cases in California. Six MCP servers are listed under the company, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for Salesforce administration and management, several ai.smithery entries from kodey-ai for running SOQL queries against a Salesforce org, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for planning deploys, opening pull requests, and triggering pipelines from an AI client.
